class.name: GDeflateDecompressor
class.brief_description: Decompresses byte arrays encoded with the GDeflate tile format.
class.description: [GDeflateDecompressor] is the software decompression counterpart to [GDeflateCompressor]. It is used automatically as a CPU fallback when a payload cannot be processed by the configured DirectStorage path.

method.name: decompress
method.description: Decompresses [param compressed] into an output array of [param original_size] bytes. Returns an empty array for invalid input or decompression failure.

method.name: get_worker_count
method.description: Returns the number of worker threads used for decompression.

method.name: set_worker_count
method.description: Sets the worker count, clamped to the range [code]1[/code] through the resolved [code]dsgd_extension/max_cpu_threads[/code] budget (auto: processors capped by the engine worker pool, up to 16; explicitly configurable up to 32). The constructor and this setter both use that budget.

members.member: Number of worker threads used for software decompression. The constructor selects a value from [code]1[/code] through the resolved [code]dsgd_extension/max_cpu_threads[/code] budget, based on available processors.
